nodes.label: Tesla fleet test/live mode column removal
Rationale: Tesla has no true sandbox, so the test/live toggle was theatre (both modes hit the same production URL)
Tesla Fleet OAuth tokens moved from plaintext tenant columns into Supabase Vault
Rationale: any service-role read of tenants exposed every connected tenant's Tesla credentials in cleartext
Rationale: connected tenants are force-disconnected because the offline_access scope bug left no refresh token to migrate
Service-role-only SECURITY DEFINER RPC boundary for Tesla token store/get/clear
Hourly Tesla Supercharger charge sync cron
Rationale: scheduled at :17 past the hour to avoid a thundering herd with jobs scheduled at :00
Service-role JWT and project URL hard-coded into the cron job body
CMD licence-status polling fallback cron (every minute)
Rationale: Modives' webhook is not pointed at us yet, so idempotent polling stands in until it is (unschedule to disable)
Poll cron posts with no Authorization header, implying a JWT-exempt edge function
AI-verified customer insurance document capability (score, findings, extracted fields)
Tenant-folder-prefixed storage isolation for uploaded insurance documents
Auto-create a conversation for every new lead
Rationale: ON CONFLICT against a partial unique index must repeat the predicate, else 42P10 500s every submit-application
Realtime publication of tenant_subscriptions so the portal paywall gate reacts to Stripe webhooks without a refresh
Vehicle Owners + Owner Payouts per-tenant feature flag (default off, super-admin flips)
Deposit hold state machine gains 'processing' and 'failed'
Rationale: 'processing' is an atomic claim sentinel so concurrent place-deposit-hold calls cannot double-charge a card; without it the CHECK violation 500s and the hold silently never lands
Per-rental security deposit amount override (falls back to tenants.global_deposit_amount)
Rationale: the new-rental deposit input was silently discarded because no column existed to store it
Auto-extension rentals: opt-in prepaid rolling renewal billing mode
Tenant-level auto-extend policy knobs (master toggle, charge mode, lead hours, grace, max retries)
Per-rental auto-extension state machine (active / awaiting_payment / paused / ended)
Two renewal charge modes: off-session saved-card auto_charge vs emailed pay_link
Partial index driving the auto-extend cron scan, mirroring the PAYG accrual scan pattern
15-minute auto-extend rentals cron
Rationale: frequent cron is safe because the function only acts when next_charge_at <= now and advances the pointer in the same write
Expense tracker: vehicle expenses widened into a full business expense model
Per-tenant custom expense categories with P&L buckets and seeded defaults
Expense-to-P&L sync trigger resolving the bucket from the tenant's category config
NULL vehicle_id means a company-wide overhead expense (and skips vehicle_events)
Backfill of pnl_entries.tenant_id so vehicle-expense P&L rows appear in tenant-scoped summaries
Private expense-receipts storage bucket
Tenant-scoped RLS for vehicle_expenses replacing the blanket allow-all policy
Rationale: vehicle_expenses carried a policy but RLS was never enabled, so isolation relied on app-side tenant filtering
P&L category CHECK extended to allow the 'Expenses' bucket
Rationale: the expense trigger wrote a bucket the CHECK constraint forbade, so cost entries failed to insert
Auto-extension control center: reminder history, calendar and manual sends
Per-rental reminder cadence for unpaid pay-links (interval days, max nudges, counters)
Per-message auto-extension reminder log with paid-through-link tracking
FIFO v2 payment allocation engine across a customer's open charges
Generic (untagged) payments may now settle Extension* charges
Rationale: captured Stripe money stranded as status='Credit' when a rental's open balance was extension-only (rental R-63b168)
Extension isolation invariant: a payment stamped to one extension can never pay another's charges
Rationale: refunds stay correct because per-extension paid_amount derives from the charge's extension_id, not the paying payment's
Category priority waterfall ranking originals (1-7) ahead of Extension* charges (8-11)
Daily 14:00 nudge cron re-sending unpaid auto-extension pay-links
One edge function serves both the cron sweep (empty body) and operator manual sends (with body)
Flexible auto-extend cadence: interval count multiplied by the period unit
Per-occurrence auto-extend schedule exceptions (skips and moves keyed by grid date)
Per-occurrence auto-extend renewal overrides (agreement, insurance, email copy) keyed by grid date
Expense-receipt storage policies scoped to the tenant folder
Rationale: bucket-only authorization let any authenticated user of any tenant read or delete any receipt
Reclassify historical P&L rows when a category's bucket changes
Rationale: the P&L trigger only fires on expense insert/update, so past rows kept the stale bucket after a reclassification
Expense categories typed business vs vehicle to filter the Add Expense dropdown
Full expense timestamp (expense_at) alongside the legacy expense_date
Rationale: expense_date is still written on insert so the P&L trigger, which keys entry_date off it, keeps working unchanged
